# Curated South China Sea evidence profiles / 南海冷泉精选证据档案

Original paraphrases; cite the primary study for scientific statements. Chinese is a reading translation; published bibliographic titles remain canonical.

以下为原始概括，科学论断请引用对应原文。中文为阅读译文，正式文献标题保留出版语言。

## Biogeographic patterns and metabolic potential of chemoautotrophic communities in cold seep sediments across subarctic to tropical regions

亚寒带至热带冷泉沉积物化能自养群落与碳固定潜力的比较

Iqbal, S., Xu, Y., Ni, L., Dang, H., Luan, X., & Zhang, D. (2026). Biogeographic patterns and metabolic potential of chemoautotrophic communities in cold seep sediments across subarctic to tropical regions. *Marine Environmental Research, 222*, Article 108410. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.marenvres.2026.108410

**Design / 研究设计**: Combine dark carbon-fixation incubations with 26 new and 107 public sediment metagenomes.

结合暗碳固定培养实验、26 个新增宏基因组和 107 个公开宏基因组。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Okhotsk Sea and South China Sea seep sediments; 133 metagenomes spanning 0–240 cm below seafloor.

鄂霍次克海与南海冷泉沉积物；133 个宏基因组覆盖海床下 0–240 cm。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: Shotgun metagenomics; Laboratory incubation; Genome-resolved metagenomic analysis

鸟枪法宏基因组测序；室内培养实验；基因组解析宏基因组分析

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: dark carbon-fixation rates; carbon-fixation pathway genes

暗碳固定速率；碳固定途径基因

**Findings / 发现**: Incubated tropical sediments had higher dark carbon-fixation rates than subarctic sediments; carbon-fixation pathway inventories also differed between regions and depths.

培养条件下热带沉积物的暗碳固定速率高于亚寒带沉积物；碳固定途径的基因组成也随区域与深度变化。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Regional comparisons combine environmental and sampling differences; incubated rates are not annual in situ carbon budgets.

区域比较同时包含环境与采样差异；培养速率不能代表年度原位碳收支。

摘要：研究设计与主要结果。

## Characterizing iron-bound organic carbon in cold seep sediment cores: impacts of anaerobic oxidation of methane

琼东南冷泉铁结合有机碳与甲烷相关碳保留

Wu, Y., Liang, Q., Liu, H., Wang, J., Xiao, X., Dong, Y., Guo, B., Ni, X., & Zhao, J. (2026). Characterizing iron-bound organic carbon in cold seep sediment cores: Impacts of anaerobic oxidation of methane. *Biogeochemistry, 169*(3), Article 29. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10533-026-01334-y

**Design / 研究设计**: Measure reactive iron-associated OC and isotope-based methane-derived carbon fractions.

测量活性铁结合有机碳及基于同位素的甲烷来源碳比例。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Qiongdongnan methane-rich and reference sediment cores.

琼东南富甲烷及对照沉积物岩芯。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: Porewater and water geochemistry; Trace-metal analysis

孔隙水与水体地球化学；痕量金属分析

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: reactive iron-bound OC and carbon isotopes

活性铁结合有机碳与碳同位素

**Findings / 发现**: Iron-bound carbon fractions generally decreased in methane-rich sediments, while isotope estimates indicated retention of some methane-related organic carbon.

富甲烷沉积物铁结合碳比例总体降低，同时同位素估计表明部分甲烷相关有机碳被保留。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Fractionation and endmember assumptions constrain source estimates; inventories do not directly determine preservation times or carbon sequestration rates.

分级与端元假设限制来源估计；存量不能直接确定保存时间或碳固定速率。

## Co-occurrence of diverse defense systems shapes complex microbe-virus relationships in deep-sea cold seeps

多种防御系统共存与深海冷泉复杂的微生物–病毒关系

Han, Y., Liao, J., Li, C., Xing, F., Peng, J., Liu, X., Xie, W., Wu, F., Jian, H., Cheng, R., & Dong, X. (2026). Co-occurrence of diverse defense systems shapes complex microbe-virus relationships in deep-sea cold seeps. *Nature Communications, 17*(1), Article 1427. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-68174-6

**Design / 研究设计**: Microbial defense and viral anti-defense genes compared across genomes; selected candidate defenses experimentally tested.

比较微生物防御和病毒反防御基因，并实验测试部分候选防御系统。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Seventeen global seep sites; SCS sequences contribute to the comparative catalog.

全球十七处冷泉；南海序列参与比较目录。

**Time / 时间**: 191 compiled metagenomes; multiple campaigns.

整合多个航次的宏基因组数据。

**Methods / 方法**: Shotgun metagenomics; Viral metagenomics; Heterologous expression

鸟枪法宏基因组测序；病毒宏基因组学；异源表达

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: microbial defense and viral anti-defense systems; candidate-defense assay outcomes; gene/transcript distributions

微生物防御与病毒反防御系统；候选防御系统测试结果；基因与转录本分布

**Findings / 发现**: The comparative catalog revealed extensive defense and anti-defense diversity, and selected candidate microbial systems protected against viral infection in laboratory assays.

比较目录揭示丰富的防御及反防御系统，部分微生物候选系统在室内实验中可抵御病毒感染。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Laboratory validation covers selected systems; co-occurrence does not establish synergism or infection rates in seep sediment.

验证仅覆盖部分系统；共存不能证明协同作用或沉积物中的感染速率。

## Deciphering the environmental fate of halogenated organic compounds in cold seep sediments: Insights from non-targeted analysis and metagenomics across vertical redox gradients

海马冷泉氧化还原梯度上的卤代有机物与脱卤微生物

Yu, H., Zhang, X., Liang, Y., Mu, Q., Shi, X., Deng, Z., Chen, J., Cao, J., Deng, Y., Han, Z., Chen, H., & Zhang, C. (2026). Deciphering the environmental fate of halogenated organic compounds in cold seep sediments: Insights from non-targeted analysis and metagenomics across vertical redox gradients. *Journal of Hazardous Materials, 507*, Article 141804. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jhazmat.2026.141804

**Design / 研究设计**: Combine non-target chemical formula assignments, sediment geochemistry and metagenomic dehalogenase profiles.

结合非靶向分子式鉴定、沉积物地球化学与宏基因组脱卤酶分析。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: A 500-cm Haima sediment core across redox zones.

跨氧化还原分区的一支 500 cm 海马沉积物岩芯。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: Shotgun metagenomics; Porewater and water geochemistry

鸟枪法宏基因组测序；孔隙水与水体地球化学

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: halogenated molecular formulas; dehalogenase gene profiles

含卤分子式；脱卤酶基因剖面

**Findings / 发现**: The study detected 669 halogenated molecular formulas; organochlorine signals declined near a redox boundary and covaried with chemistry and dehalogenase inventories.

研究检出 669 个含卤分子式；有机氯信号在氧化还原边界附近降低，并与化学条件及脱卤酶基因组成共变。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Formula-level assignments do not resolve every chemical structure; correlations cannot separate microbial removal from burial and transport.

分子式层面鉴定不能解析全部化学结构；相关性不能区分微生物去除、埋藏和输运。

## Discovery and characterization of Chondroitinase A with specificity for 4-O-sulfated N-acetylgalactosamine in Chondroitin sulfate/Dermatan sulfate

海马冷泉宏基因组来源软骨素酶 A 的底物特异性与功能鉴定

Wang, W., Yi, H., Zi, P., Wang, X., Zou, R., Zhang, Y.-Z., & Li, F. (2026). Discovery and characterization of chondroitinase a with specificity for 4-O-sulfated n-acetylgalactosamine in chondroitin sulfate/dermatan sulfate. *Journal of Biological Chemistry*, Article 113594. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbc.2026.113594

**Design / 研究设计**: Characterize a PL8 lyase using defined oligosaccharides, product analysis and site-directed mutagenesis.

采用结构明确的寡糖、产物分析和定点突变，鉴定一种 PL8 裂解酶。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Sediments near Haima; a recovered enzyme tested outside the habitat.

海马附近沉积物；功能实验针对重建的酶开展。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: Shotgun metagenomics; Heterologous expression

鸟枪法宏基因组测序；异源表达

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: substrate specificity and enzyme activity; mutant phenotypes

底物特异性与酶活性；突变体表型

**Findings / 发现**: The recovered enzyme selectively cleaved chondroitin/dermatan sulfate motifs containing GalNAc or GalNAc4S; mutagenesis identified residues required for activity.

该酶对含 GalNAc 或 GalNAc4S 的软骨素／皮肤素硫酸基序具有选择性；突变实验识别了活性所必需的残基。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Purified-enzyme specificity does not establish substrate availability, expression or turnover in seep sediments.

纯化酶的特异性不能证明相应底物在冷泉中的供应、酶的表达或原位周转。

## Distance‐Limited Larval Replenishment in the Deep‐Sea Mussel Gigantidas platifrons Challenges Connectivity‐Based Conservation Planning

F 站位贻贝的局地补充与甲烷氧化共生菌的遗传组成

Zhong, Z., Zhou, L., Chen, H., Cai, C., Yan, Y., Ye, Z., Li, M., Wang, J., Zhang, H., Wang, H., Cao, L., Sun, Y., Lian, C., Guo, Y., Feng, J., Wang, M., & Li, C. (2026). Distance‐limited larval replenishment in the deep‐sea mussel *Gigantidas platifrons* challenges connectivity‐based conservation planning. *Molecular Ecology, 35*(14), Article e70476. https://doi.org/10.1111/mec.70476

**Design / 研究设计**: Compare regional host population structure, local kinship and symbiont genetic variation among size cohorts.

比较区域宿主种群结构、局地亲缘关系及不同体型组的共生菌遗传差异。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Gigantidas platifrons at 11 Northwest Pacific sites; six size cohorts and Methyloprofundus symbionts at Site F.

西北太平洋 11 个站位的 Gigantidas platifrons；重点比较 F 站位六个体型组及 Methyloprofundus 共生菌。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: Whole-genome resequencing; Phylogenetic analysis

全基因组重测序；系统发育分析

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: host kinship and population structure; symbiont genetic differentiation

宿主亲缘与种群结构；共生菌遗传分化

**Findings / 发现**: Local host kinship declined with distance, whereas Site F methanotrophic symbionts showed low differentiation across host cohorts.

宿主局地亲缘程度随距离降低，而 F 站位甲烷氧化共生菌在不同宿主体型组间的遗传分化较低。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Shell size is not a direct longitudinal record; genetic similarity alone does not demonstrate continuous acquisition from an environmental reservoir.

壳体大小并非直接的纵向观测；遗传相似性本身不能证明共生菌持续从环境菌库获取。

## Diversification in ANME-1 archaea is associated with the presence of highly variable genomic hotspots

ANME-1 古菌分化与高度可变基因组热点的关联

Zhou, Y.-L., Feng, J.-C., Lu, R., Chen, Z., Mara, P., Tao, X., Liu, J., Huang, Y., Hu, J., Yao, J., Edgcomb, V. P., Teske, A., Wang, X., & Zhang, S. (2026). Diversification in ANME-1 archaea is associated with the presence of highly variable genomic hotspots. *Nature Communications, 17*(1), Article 6791. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-73573-4

**Design / 研究设计**: Long-read reconstruction of circular MAGs, genomic-hotspot comparisons, and heterologous tests of hicAB operons.

通过长读长重建环状 MAG，比较基因组热点，并异源测试 hicAB 操纵子。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Haima sediment core at 1435 m water depth; four depth intervals within 30 cm.

水深 1435 m 的海马岩芯，分析 30 cm 内四个深度区间。

**Time / 时间**: June–July 2022 KEXUE/FaXian cruise.

2022 年 6–7 月 KEXUE／FaXian 航次。

**Methods / 方法**: Long-read metagenomics; Genome-resolved metagenomic analysis; Heterologous expression

长读长宏基因组学；基因组解析宏基因组分析；异源表达

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: circular ANME-1 genomes; genomic hotspots; hicAB heterologous phenotypes

环状 ANME-1 基因组；基因组热点；hicAB 异源表达表型

**Findings / 发现**: ANME-1 genomes contained variable hotspots associated with defense, transport, and methane-metabolism genes; heterologous hicAB tests supported toxin–antitoxin function.

ANME-1 可变热点涉及防御、转运和甲烷代谢基因；异源 hicAB 实验支持其毒素–抗毒素功能。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: One core and heterologous assays do not prove the drivers of speciation or stress responses in natural ANME populations.

单支岩芯与异源实验不能证明自然 ANME 种群的物种形成驱动或胁迫响应机制。

## Draft genome sequence of hydrocarbon-utilizing Stenotrophomonas sp. strain WO2 isolated from Haima cold seep sediments in the South China Sea

海马沉积物烃利用菌 Stenotrophomonas WO2 的基因组草图

Chen, T., Zhou, H., Zhang, X., & Zhan, J. (2026). Draft genome sequence of hydrocarbon-utilizing *Stenotrophomonas* sp. strain WO2 isolated from Haima cold seep sediments in the South China Sea. *Microbiology Resource Announcements, 15*(7), Article e00179-26. https://doi.org/10.1128/mra.00179-26

分离可利用原油的菌株并组装基因组草图。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Stenotrophomonas WO2 isolated from Haima sediment using crude oil as sole carbon source.

以原油为唯一碳源从海马沉积物分离的 Stenotrophomonas WO2。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

微生物培养；分离株基因组测序

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: genome size and GC content

基因组大小与 GC 含量

**Findings / 发现**: WO2 supplied a 4,772,190-bp draft genome with 66.01% GC content for investigating seep-derived hydrocarbon-utilizing bacteria.

## Enrichment of potential polyvinyl chloride and polycarbonate microplastic-degrading bacteria and their distribution characteristics in deep-sea cold seep

海马冷泉 PVC 与聚碳酸酯潜在降解菌的富集与分布

Wu, Q., Feng, J., Huang, Y., & Zhang, S. (2026). Enrichment of potential polyvinyl chloride and polycarbonate microplastic-degrading bacteria and their distribution characteristics in deep-sea cold seep. *Marine Pollution Bulletin, 231*, Article 119819. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.marpolbul.2026.119819

**Design / 研究设计**: Incubate PVC and polycarbonate films, inspect surface changes and track bacterial amplicon variants.

培养 PVC 和聚碳酸酯膜，检查表面变化并跟踪细菌扩增子变体。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Haima cold-seep plastic enrichments and environmental water/sediment comparisons.

海马冷泉塑料富集体系及环境水体、沉积物比较。

**Time / 时间**: One-year in situ incubation followed by 189-day laboratory enrichment.

一年原位培养及 189 天室内富集。

**Methods / 方法**: In situ incubation; Laboratory incubation; 16S/18S amplicon sequencing

原位培养；室内培养实验；16S/18S 扩增子测序

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: film alteration and enrichment growth; candidate ASV distributions

膜表面变化与富集生长；候选 ASV 分布

**Findings / 发现**: Plastic-associated enrichments grew and altered film surfaces; abundance changes identified candidate degraders, with candidate signals more abundant in seawater than sediment.

塑料相关富集群落可生长并改变膜表面；丰度变化识别出候选降解菌，其信号在海水中高于沉积物。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Candidate ASVs and surface damage do not individually prove polymer mineralization or quantify natural removal rates.

候选 ASV 与表面损伤本身不能证明聚合物完全矿化，也不能量化天然去除速率。

## Fate of deep methane bubble plumes at the Haima cold seeps in the South China Sea

海马深海甲烷气泡羽流的输运与溶解命运

Guo, B., Su, D., Yang, S., Xu, A., Bu, X., Chen, Z., Wu, X., Feng, Q., Chen, C., Wang, F., Wu, Y., Dong, Y., Xiao, X., & Liang, Q. (2026). Fate of deep methane bubble plumes at the Haima cold seeps in the South China Sea. *Marine Pollution Bulletin, 226*, Article 119308. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.marpolbul.2026.119308

**Design / 研究设计**: Integrate bubble/plume imaging, dissolved-methane profiles, moored currents and numerical simulations.

结合气泡／羽流成像、溶解甲烷剖面、系泊海流及数值模拟。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Haima HM01/HMS18 seeps at 1,408–1,522-m seabed depth.

海马 HM01／HMS18 冷泉，海床水深 1,408–1,522 m。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: In situ seabed monitoring; Porewater and water geochemistry; Ocean biogeochemical modeling

海底原位监测；孔隙水与水体地球化学；海洋生物地球化学模拟

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: plume geometry, currents and methane concentrations

羽流几何、海流与甲烷浓度

**Findings / 发现**: Observed bubbles reached near the hydrate-stability upper boundary, while dissolved methane decreased by 1–2 orders within 20–40 m above vents.

## New Microbial Lineages Capable of Carbon Fixation and Nutrient Cycling in Deep-Sea Sediments of the Northern South China Sea

九龙甲烷礁邻近沉积物未培养微生物的固碳与营养循环潜力

Huang, J.-M., Baker, B. J., Li, J.-T., & Wang, Y. (2019). New microbial lineages capable of carbon fixation and nutrient cycling in deep-sea sediments of the northern South China Sea. *Applied and Environmental Microbiology, 85*(15), Article e00523-19. https://doi.org/10.1128/aem.00523-19

**Design / 研究设计**: Recover eleven >85%-complete genomes and inspect pathway genes and transcript support.

重建十一个完整度 >85% 的基因组，检查途径基因与转录支持。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: A core near Jiulong methane reef at 1,100-m water depth in northern SCS.

南海北部水深 1,100 m 九龙甲烷礁附近一支岩芯。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: Genome-resolved metagenomic analysis; Metatranscriptomics

基因组解析宏基因组分析；宏转录组学

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: MAG completeness and pathway transcripts

MAG 完整度与途径转录

**Findings / 发现**: Nine phyla included uncultivated archaeal/bacterial lineages with carbon-fixation, organic-substrate use and nutrient-reduction potential; several pathway genes were transcribed.

九个门包括未培养古菌／细菌类群，具有固碳、有机底物利用及营养元素还原潜力；部分途径基因有转录支持。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Transcription is stronger evidence than gene presence but does not establish complete pathway activity, partner exchange or flux.

转录比仅有基因更有支持力，但不能确定完整途径活性、伙伴交换或通量。

## The Distribution of Dissolved Methane and Its Air-Sea Flux in the Plume of a Seep Field, Lingtou Promontory, South China Sea

岭头岬浅海渗漏区溶解甲烷及海气交换估计

Di, P., Feng, D., & Chen, D. (2019). The distribution of dissolved methane and its air-sea flux in the plume of a seep field, Lingtou Promontory, South China Sea. *Geofluids, 2019*, 1–12. https://doi.org/10.1155/2019/3240697

**Design / 研究设计**: Measure surface/bottom methane and carbon isotopes and estimate air–sea flux.

测量表层／底层甲烷及碳同位素，并估计海气通量。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: 48 stations over 56 km² near Lingtou Promontory/Yinggehai Basin.

岭头岬／莺歌海盆地附近 56 km² 内 48 个站位。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: Porewater and water geochemistry

孔隙水与水体地球化学

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: methane distribution, isotopes and modeled air–sea flux

甲烷分布、同位素与模型海气通量

**Findings / 发现**: Dissolved methane showed large spatial variation and generally stronger bottom-water enrichment; isotopes supported mixed biogenic and thermogenic sources.

溶解甲烷具有较大空间变化，底层水总体富集更强；同位素支持生物成因与热成因混合来源。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: A shallow coastal seep cannot represent deep Haima/Site F transport; air–sea flux is an estimate, not a measured microbial oxidation rate.

浅海近岸渗漏不能代表深海海马／F 站位输运；海气通量为估计，并非微生物氧化速率测量。

## Characteristics of phytoplankton communities and their biomass variation in a gas hydrate drilling area in the northern South China Sea

东沙水合物钻探区浮游植物、营养盐及季节比较

Wang, Y., Kang, J.-H., Liang, Q.-Y., He, X.-B., Wang, J.-J., & Lin, M. (2018). Characteristics of phytoplankton communities and their biomass variation in a gas hydrate drilling area in the northern South China Sea. *Marine Pollution Bulletin, 133*, 606–615. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.marpolbul.2018.06.018

**Design / 研究设计**: Compare phytoplankton counts, chlorophyll, nutrients and dissolved methane before and after drilling.

比较钻探前后浮游植物计数、叶绿素、营养盐与溶解甲烷。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Dongsha hydrate-drilling water column.

东沙水合物钻探区水柱。

**Time / 时间**: May and October 2013 observations; article published in 2018.

2013 年 5 月、10 月观测；论文发表于 2018 年。

**Methods / 方法**: Porewater and water geochemistry; Diagnostic pigment analysis

孔隙水与水体地球化学；诊断色素分析

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: phytoplankton abundance, nutrients and chlorophyll

浮游植物丰度、营养盐与叶绿素

**Findings / 发现**: Phosphate/chlorophyll increased between surveys while phytoplankton abundance did not change significantly; methane showed no significant direct association in the reported analysis.

调查间磷酸盐／叶绿素增加，浮游植物丰度未显著变化；报告分析未发现甲烷显著直接关联。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Drilling status is confounded with season; proposed plume upwelling does not establish a drilling-caused phytoplankton response.

钻探状态与季节混杂；提出的羽流上升流不能证明钻探导致浮游植物响应。

## In situ Raman Quantitative Detection of the Cold Seep Vents and Fluids in the Chemosynthetic Communities in the South China Sea

福尔摩沙冷泉流体原位拉曼探测与化学梯度

Du, Z., Zhang, X., Luan, Z., Wang, M., Xi, S., Li, L., Wang, B., Cao, L., Lian, C., Li, C., & Yan, J. (2018). In situ Raman quantitative detection of the cold seep vents and fluids in the chemosynthetic communities in the South China Sea. *Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems, 19*(7), 2049–2061. https://doi.org/10.1029/2018gc007496

**Design / 研究设计**: Combine in situ Raman probe measurements, gas chromatography and carbon isotopes.

结合原位拉曼探针、气相色谱及碳同位素。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Formosa Ridge vent and fluids within chemosynthetic communities.

福尔摩沙海脊泉口及化能合成群落内部流体。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: Porewater and water geochemistry; In situ seabed monitoring

孔隙水与水体地球化学；海底原位监测

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: Raman gas signals and sulfate/sulfur gradients

拉曼气体信号与硫酸盐／硫梯度

**Findings / 发现**: Vent/fluid measurements detected methane and other reduced gases; community-fluid depth profiles showed sulfate depletion and methane/elemental-sulfur changes.

泉口／流体测量检出甲烷等还原气体；群落流体深度剖面显示硫酸盐消耗及甲烷／单质硫变化。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Geochemical gradients support reaction hypotheses but cannot independently identify organisms, electron-transfer routes or process rates.

地球化学梯度支持反应假说，却不能独立识别微生物、电子传递途径或过程速率。

## The vertical distribution of prokaryotes in the surface sediment of Jiaolong cold seep at the northern South China Sea

蛟龙冷泉表层沉积物原核微生物的垂向分布

Wu, Y., Qiu, J.-W., Qian, P.-Y., & Wang, Y. (2018). The vertical distribution of prokaryotes in the surface sediment of Jiaolong cold seep at the northern South China Sea. *Extremophiles, 22*(3), 499–510. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00792-018-1012-0

**Design / 研究设计**: Pair 16S pyrosequencing with methane/sulfur/nitrate functional genes in metagenomes.

结合 16S 焦磷酸测序与宏基因组甲烷／硫／硝酸盐功能基因。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Jiaolong sediments, comparing 0–6 and 8–14 cm layers.

蛟龙沉积物，比较 0–6 与 8–14 cm 层。

**Time / 时间**: Sampling date not specified in the inspected abstract.

所核查摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: 16S/18S amplicon sequencing; Shotgun metagenomics

16S/18S 扩增子测序；鸟枪法宏基因组测序

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: vertical community and functional-gene distributions

群落与功能基因垂向分布

**Findings / 发现**: Surface layers favored sulfur oxidizers and ANME-1, whereas deeper layers favored sulfate reducers and ANME-1/2; sulfur/nitrate genes covaried near the surface.

表层偏富集硫氧化菌和 ANME-1，深层偏富集硫酸盐还原菌及 ANME-1／2；表层硫／硝酸盐基因共变。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Gene co-distribution does not directly establish electron-acceptor coupling or partner-specific syntrophy.

基因共同分布不能直接确定电子受体耦合或特定伙伴互营。

## Methane-metabolizing microbial communities in sediments of the Haima cold seep area, northwest slope of the South China Sea

南海西北坡海马冷泉沉积物中的甲烷代谢微生物群落

Niu, M., Fan, X., Zhuang, G., Liang, Q., & Wang, F. (2017). Methane-metabolizing microbial communities in sediments of the Haima cold seep area, northwest slope of the South China Sea. *FEMS Microbiology Ecology, 93*(9). https://doi.org/10.1093/femsec/fix101

**Design / 研究设计**: Two piston cores compared using geochemical profiles, archaeal 16S rRNA genes, and mcrA phylogeny.

比较两支活塞岩芯的地球化学剖面、古菌 16S rRNA 基因及 mcrA 系统发育特征。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: Haima seep core QDN-14B and non-seep core QDN-31B, northwestern South China Sea.

南海西北部海马冷泉岩芯 QDN-14B 及非冷泉对照岩芯 QDN-31B。

**Time / 时间**: Cross-sectional piston-core comparison; collection date not specified in the inspected abstract.

活塞岩芯的横断面比较；已查阅摘要未说明采样日期。

**Methods / 方法**: 16S/18S amplicon sequencing; Quantitative PCR; Porewater and water geochemistry

16S/18S 扩增子测序；定量 PCR；孔隙水与水体地球化学

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: archaeal marker-gene diversity and abundance; mcrA phylogeny; sulfate and dissolved inorganic carbon profiles

古菌标记基因多样性与丰度；mcrA 系统发育关系；硫酸盐与溶解无机碳剖面

**Findings / 发现**: ANME lineages occupied different sediment niches: ANME-2a/b predominated in upper and middle sulfate–methane transition layers, whereas ANME-1b was more prominent in deeper sulfate-depleted layers.

ANME 谱系具有不同的沉积物生态位：ANME-2a/b 在硫酸盐–甲烷转换带上部和中部较丰富，ANME-1b 在更深的硫酸盐贫化层中更突出。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Two cores describe local zonation; marker-gene occurrence does not identify electron-transfer mechanisms.

两支岩芯仅反映局地分层；标记基因的存在不能确定电子传递机制。

## Molecular identification of methane monooxygenase and quantitative analysis of methanotrophic endosymbionts under laboratory maintenance inBathymodiolus platifronsfrom the South China Sea

甲烷供应对冷泉贻贝室内暂养共生菌数量的影响

Sun, Y., Wang, M., Li, L., Zhou, L., Wang, X., Zheng, P., Yu, H., Li, C., & Sun, S. (2017). Molecular identification of methane monooxygenase and quantitative analysis of methanotrophic endosymbionts under laboratory maintenance inbathymodiolus platifronsfrom the South China Sea. *PeerJ, 5*, Article e3565. https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.3565

**Design / 研究设计**: Identify pmoABC, quantify symbiont marker DNA and verify abundance changes by microscopy.

鉴定 pmoABC，定量共生菌标记 DNA，并通过显微观察验证数量变化。

**Sampling scope / 采样范围**: SCS Bathymodiolus platifrons and its gill methanotrophic symbionts.

南海 Bathymodiolus platifrons 及其鳃甲烷氧化共生菌。

**Time / 时间**: 34-day laboratory maintenance with and without methane.

34 天有甲烷与无甲烷室内暂养。

**Methods / 方法**: Quantitative PCR; Phylogenetic analysis; Laboratory incubation

定量 PCR；系统发育分析；室内培养实验

**Measured or derived / 测量或推导指标**: symbiont marker DNA and microscopy

共生菌标记 DNA 与显微观察

**Findings / 发现**: Symbiont abundance declined during maintenance; decline was greater without methane at days 24 and 34.

暂养期间共生菌数量下降，第 24、34 天无甲烷处理的下降更明显。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Marker-DNA abundance and laboratory methane supply do not quantify native symbiont carbon fixation or transfer to the host.

标记 DNA 丰度及室内甲烷供应不能量化天然共生菌碳固定或向宿主转移。
